content:
Hana Chen: Heads up - seeing a huge hole in traces for the us-west GPU pool after a node drain at ~03:14. Prom shows pod restarts + kube-probe flaps. Traces drop between nginx ingress and runtime.
Theo Martins: Which runtime cluster? prod-gpu-1?
Hana Chen: prod-runtime/gpu-pool-1 yes. Ingress has trace ids, runtime shows none. Gateway logs: 
```
2026-03-18T03:14:12Z gateway ERROR missing traceparent for req=0x4a7f3a user=svc-runtime
2026-03-18T03:14:12Z gateway WARN proxy stripped header Traceparent for 12% of requests
```
Jules Park: That log line rings a bell — there was a recent nginx change that zeroes some headers when forwarding. Also some services were bumped to otel-js 1.4 last week and we changed default propagators.
Theo Martins: Also seeing nodepressure evictions during the drain; pods restarted mid-request which could mean the runtime didn't flush spans. Eviction spike graph: https://grafana.company.net/d/abcd/evictions?orgId=1&var-region=us-west
Hana Chen: Grafana alert "Trace rate drop (us-west, gpu)" fired repeatedly and flooded #incidents. Rule currently triggers on 50% drop in span rate over 2m, no for: so it noisy.
Jules Park: Quick debugging checklist: 1) inspect nginx commit that touched proxy_set_header 2) check OTEL_PROPAGATORS env across services 3) verify gateway doesn't drop traceparent when proxying chunked/stream requests.
Hana Chen: Found a recent nginx snippet in ingress helm values: 
```
proxy_set_header Traceparent ""; # introduced in chart v2.11.3 to sanitize headers
```
Hana Chen: ...which would explain header being blanked.
Theo Martins: Ops mitigation plan: revert nginx change in canary, and simultaneously canary-rollback services that upgraded to otel-js 1.4 back to 1.3.2 so propagators match. Also add for: 5m to the Grafana rule to reduce alert noise.
Jules Park: Agreed. Also propose adding a gateway metric: gateway_traceparent_missing_total and an alert on >0 for 5m to catch header-scrub regressions before trace rate drops.
infra-bot: Deploy job created: ingress/helm-revert-canary -> sha: 7b2f9a; started by @Jules Park. ETA ~6m.
sre-oncall: I'm silencing Grafana rule id=1042 (Trace rate drop - us-west gpu) for 30m to stop alert fatigue.
Hana Chen: Quick config snippets to apply in canary: 
OTEL_PROPAGATORS=tracecontext,baggage
OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=parentbased_always_on
(ensure otel-sdk version = 1.3.2)

Jules Park: Opening PR to revert the ingress header scrub and add an automated e2e to assert traceparent is forwarded across ingress -> runtime. PR: https://git.company/repo/pulls/5432
Theo Martins: Also adding a Prom rule: 
```
- record: gateway:traceparent_missing:rate5m
  expr: increase(gateway_traceparent_missing_total{region="us-west"}[5m])
```
and then alert if > 0 for 2m.
Hana Chen: Root cause candidates captured: 1) ingress helm change scrubbed Traceparent header 2) propagator mismatch (otel-js 1.4 vs 1.3) 3) pod eviction causing unflushed spans. Plan: revert ingress -> verify traces in canary -> rollback sdk in runtime canary if needed -> reinstate alerts with for: 5m -> add gateway metric + e2e test.
sre-oncall: sounds good, no objections. Will monitor.
Hana Chen: Thanks — I'll update when ingress canary completes and we verify spans. :thumbsup:
